newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Sonae H1 net seen 2.0-3.5 bln esc.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Sonae H1 net seen 2.0-3.5 bln esc.

text.p: The first half earnings of Portuguese industrial group Sonae Investimentos, due next Monday, are forecast at between 2.0 and 3.5 billion escudos, well down on the year-ago figure which was boosted by a large windfall gain, analysts said.
Sonae, Portugal's biggest industrial holding, posted a consolidated net profit of 6.3 billion escudos in the first six months of 1995.

"Net profits of Sonae Investimentos in the first six months will be less than in the same year-ago period, because this time there will not be extraordinary results," said Jose Freire, analyst with Lisbon broker Gesfinc.
A broker's analyst, who asked not to be identified, said: "The first half Sonae results are in line with the 1995 numbers, but without extraordinaries."

In the first six months of 1995, Sonae had a four billion escudos extraordinary profit from the group's sale of a stake in Banco Portugues do Atlantico, Portugal's second biggest bank purchased by Banco Comercial Portugues in March that year.

Pierre Boulle, chief equities analyst with Lisbon broker Fincor, said: "Our forecast points to six-month net profits of between 2.5 and 3.5 billion escudos for Sonae Investimentos, based on growth in sales and considering the lack of extraordinaries."
Another analyst, who asked not to be identified, said: "As far as I know, at least until June 30, Sonae sold nothing significant."

Gesfinc's Freire said: "There has been a considerable improvement in the wood products group, Sonae Industria, and we should see an improvement -- because more business is going on -- in Sonae Investimentos's real estate activities; and retail distribution should show similar earnings to the same year-ago period."

In the first six months of 1995, Sonae Industria posted a consolidated net profit of 200 million escudos, hypermarkets group Modelo Continente posted 2.4 billion escudos profit and hypermarkets holding Modelo-SGPS 1.8 billion escudos profit.
